payload.summary: The treasury management strategy for 2026/27. Full Council sets an authorised limit for external debt — the legal ceiling — of £344.409m for 2025/26 and £350.179m for 2026/27, against actual external borrowing of £145.948m. It also carries the council's own indicator for how much of its core money comes from commercial property and lending: 4% in 2024/25, down from 16% in 2021/22.
